column3: “Answered and said” is rendered “continued and said.”
“People of heart” is rendered “men of understanding”; NASB supplies “to do.”
“Assign on him” is rendered “gave Him authority over.”
“Set his heart to it” is rendered “determine to do so”; the written and read forms differ.
“If understanding” is rendered “if you have understanding.”
“To say to a king” is rendered “Who says to a king”; NASB follows a slight change of vowels.
“Lifts up the faces” is rendered “shows … partiality.”
“Not by a hand” is rendered “without a hand.”
“He will not appoint again on a person” is rendered “He does not need to consider a man further”; the meaning is uncertain.
“In place of the wicked” is rendered “like the wicked,” and “a place of those who see” as “a public place.”
NASB supplies “So that … should not” and “Nor be”; the meaning is uncertain.
